meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会拿你指定的一个文档交给 NotebookLM 生成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF，存到源文件旁并以 <文件名>-slides.pdf 命名；若配置了 WOWerpoint 服务器，还会上传并返回一个手机端分享链接。
howto.when: 当你说「wowerpoint 这个」、「给 <文件> 做份幻灯片」、「把这份报告转成 slides」等，或要求把单个文档渲染成分章叙述的幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 把这份报告做成幻灯片，用可爱角色讲故事
say.note: 你给的提示词会原样传给 NotebookLM

say.text: 把这篇文档转成 kawaii 幻灯片
say.note: 约 10 分钟产出 PDF，配置后另有分享链接

howto.what_en: Claude takes one document you name, has NotebookLM render a kawaii slide-deck PDF next to the source as <stem>-slides.pdf, then (if the WOWerpoint server is set up) uploads it and returns a mobile share link.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", and similar requests to render one document as narrative slides.

say_en.text: Turn this report into slides with kawaii characters
say_en.note: Your prompt is passed through verbatim

say_en.text: Make a kawaii deck from this document
say_en.note: PDF in ~10 min, plus a share link if configured
